threatModel.summary: Pure-FTPd 1.0.54 is a network-facing FTP server. Untrusted remote clients speak FTP over cleartext or TLS and can authenticate as anonymous or virtual/real users. After authentication, the server exposes filesystem operations constrained by chroot/jail and per-user permissions; optional backends (PureDB, PAM, LDAP, SQL, external auth), TLS SNI helpers, upload scripts, quotas, logging, and local admin utilities create additional trust boundaries. The primary assets are host files outside the FTP jail, credentials and authentication decisions, user files and quotas, helper process integrity, and service availability.
trustBoundaries: unauthenticated network client to FTP control parser
authenticated FTP user to chrooted filesystem namespace
FTP daemon to root-owned configuration, PureDB and quota files
FTP daemon to external auth/cert helper processes
TLS client SNI to certificate selection
upload notification pipe to external upload script
